benefits.name: Anniversary Free Night Award
benefits.estimate_basis: Award redeemable at Category 1-4 hotels, which top out at 15,000 World of Hyatt points, valued at 1.6 cents per point per The Points Guy July 2026 valuations. This is the category ceiling, not a typical redemption.
benefits.merchant_scope: One night at any Category 1-4 Hyatt hotel or resort
benefits.notes: Issued each year after the cardmember anniversary.

benefits.name: Free Night Award after $15,000 spend
benefits.estimate_basis: Same Category 1-4 ceiling as the anniversary award: 15,000 points at 1.6 cents per point per The Points Guy July 2026 valuations.
benefits.merchant_scope: One night at any Category 1-4 Hyatt hotel or resort
benefits.notes: A second award earned after $15,000 of calendar-year spend. Reported as unlockable (SPEC §4.7).

benefits.name: World of Hyatt Discoverist status
benefits.notes: Complimentary elite status while the card is open, plus five qualifying night credits each year. No dollar value is tracked.
